strings.tierB.home.title: FieldSales: Pulogalamu ya ogulitsa ndi kugulitsa m'galimoto
strings.tierB.home.description: Pulogalamu ya ogawa katundu: ma invoyisi ndi malisiti pa foni ya wogulitsa, sitoko ya galimoto, ndalama ndi maulendo. Imagwira ntchito popanda intaneti.
strings.tierB.home.h1: Yang'anirani ogulitsa anu kuyambira ulendo woyamba mpaka malipiro omaliza
strings.tierB.home.definition: FieldSales ndi pulatifomu ya pa intaneti (cloud) ya makampani ogawa katundu ndi ogulitsa katundu wambiri omwe ali ndi ogulitsa oyendera makasitomala. Ogulitsa amapereka ndi kusindikiza ma invoyisi ndi malisiti pa foni yawo, amatsatira sitoko ya galimoto ndi kulemba maulendo, pamene oyang'anira amaona malonda, ndalama zotoleredwa ndi ngongole za makasitomala nthawi yomweyo.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.title: Ma invoyisi pa foni ya wogulitsa
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.line: Wogulitsa amapereka invoyisi pakhomo pa kasitomala ndi kuisindikiza pa pulinta ya thermal ya Bluetooth asanatuluke m'sitolo.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.title: Ndalama zotoleredwa ndi ngongole za makasitomala
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.line: Malipiro aliwonse amalandira lisiti ya nambala yolumikizidwa ndi ma invoyisi omwe akulipira, ndipo ngongole ndi sitetimenti ya kasitomala zimasintha nthawi yomweyo.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.title: Sitoko ya galimoto yoyang'aniridwa ndi wogulitsa
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.line: Sitoko ya galimoto iliyonse imatsatiridwa chinthu ndi chinthu: chokwezedwa, chogulitsidwa, chobwezedwa ndi chotsala, kotero kusiyana kumaonekera tsiku lomwelo.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.title: Njira ndi maulendo
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.line: Maulendo amalembedwa ndi malo, nthawi ndi zithunzi, ndipo njira ya wogulitsa aliyense imaonetsedwa pa mapu kuti woyang'anira aione.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.title: Imagwira ntchito popanda intaneti
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.line: Ogulitsa amapitiriza kugulitsa ngakhale palibe netiweki. Zikalata zimadikira pa foni ndipo zimatumizidwa zokha, popanda kubwerezedwa, intaneti ikabwera.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.title: Dashboard ya pa webu ya oyang'anira
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.line: Malonda, ndalama zotoleredwa, katundu wobwezedwa, sitoko ndi momwe ogulitsa akuchitira pamalo amodzi, pamodzi ndi maudindo ndi maufulu a wogwiritsa ntchito aliyense.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.title: Tiuzeni mmene mumagulitsira
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.line: Pemphani kotesheni kapena sungitsani msonkhano. Timaona ogulitsa anu, njira, zogulitsa ndi zosowa zanu za ma invoyisi.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.title: Konzani kampani yanu
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.line: Lowetsani zogulitsa, mitengo, makasitomala ndi ogulitsa, ndipo ikani ndalama ndi mlingo wa msonkho wa dziko lanu m'makonzedwe.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.title: Tumizani ogulitsa m'njira
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.line: Ogulitsa amaika app pa Android kapena iPhone, amakweza katundu m'galimoto yawo ndipo amayamba kugulitsa, kusindikiza ndi kutolera ndalama.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.title: Tsatirani tsiku pamene likuchitika
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.line: Dashboard ya pa webu imaonetsa malonda, ndalama zotoleredwa, sitoko ya magalimoto ndi maulendo ogulitsa ali m'njira.
strings.tierB.home.faq.0.a: FieldSales ndi pulatifomu ya pa intaneti (cloud) yoyang'anira ogulitsa omwe amayendera makasitomala m'makampani ogawa katundu ndi ogulitsa katundu wambiri. Imaphatikizapo kugulitsa kuchokera m'galimoto (van sales), kugulitsa m'njira zokonzedwa (route sales), kutenga maoda pasadakhale (pre-sales) ndi kupereka katundu molunjika ku masitolo (DSD). Ogulitsa amapereka ma invoyisi, amasindikiza, amatolera ndalama ndi kulemba maulendo pa foni yawo, ndipo oyang'anira amatsatira malonda, ndalama zotoleredwa, sitoko ya magalimoto ndi ngongole za makasitomala pa dashboard ya pa webu.
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.q: Kodi FieldSales imagwira ntchito popanda intaneti?
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.a: Inde. App ya wogulitsa imapitiriza kugwira ntchito popanda intaneti: ogulitsa amapereka ndi kusindikiza ma invoyisi ndi malisiti, amalemba maulendo ndi kuwonjezera makasitomala atsopano, ndipo zonse zimatumizidwa zokha popanda kubwerezedwa intaneti ikabwera. Pali kusiyana kumodzi ku Saudi Arabia: makampani amene atsegula kulumikizana kwa ma invoyisi a pa intaneti amafunika intaneti panthawi yopereka invoyisi kapena chikalata cha katundu wobwezedwa.
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.a: FieldSales imatumikira makampani ogawa katundu m'mayiko onse. Kampani iliyonse imaika ndalama zake ndi mlingo wa msonkho m'makonzedwe ake, ndipo ma invoyisi, malisiti ndi malipoti zimagwiritsa ntchito zimenezo. Likulu la FieldSales lili ku Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, ndipo kuyamba kumachitika pa intaneti kudzera m'misonkhano, WhatsApp ndi chithandizo chochokera kutali.
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.q: Kodi FieldSales imalumikizana ndi madongosolo a boma a ma invoyisi a pa intaneti?
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.a: Timathandizira kulumikizana kwa Gawo Lachiwiri ndi pulatifomu ya Fatoora ya ZATCA. Izi zimagwira ntchito kwa makampani a ku Saudi Arabia. M'mayiko ena, FieldSales imapereka ma invoyisi ndi ndalama zanu komanso mlingo wanu wa msonkho, ndipo kulumikizana ndi dongosolo la dziko la ma invoyisi a pa intaneti (e-invoicing) kumapezeka mukapempha, titaunika pamodzi nanu zofunikira za dzikolo. Kunja kwa Saudi Arabia sitikulonjeza chilichonse chokhudza malamulo a kumeneko.
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.q: Kodi app ya FieldSales imapezeka m'zilankhulo ziti?
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.a: App ya FieldSales imapezeka m'zilankhulo izi zokha: Arabic, English, French, Turkish and Chinese. Sipezeka m'Chichewa. Ogulitsa ndi oyang'anira akhoza kusintha chilankhulo cha app, ndipo ma invoyisi osindikizidwa akhoza kukhala ndi chilankhulo chachiwiri pambali pa chilankhulo chachikulu. Masamba a webusayiti m'zilankhulo zina, monga tsamba lino la Chichewa, ndi matanthauzidwe opereka chidziwitso cha pulogalamuyi.
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.a: Pemphani kotesheni, sungitsani msonkhano kapena titumizireni uthenga pa WhatsApp. Timaphunzira mmene ogulitsa anu amagwirira ntchito, kenako timakuthandizani kukonza zogulitsa, mitengo, makasitomala ndi ogulitsa. Ogulitsa amaika app pa Android kapena iPhone, ndipo oyang'anira amagwiritsa ntchito dashboard ya pa webu pa msakatuli uliwonse. Zipangizo zokha zomwe mukufunika ndi mafoni a smartphone.
strings.tierB.home.uiLanguagesNote: App ya FieldSales imapezeka m'zilankhulo izi: Arabic, English, French, Turkish and Chinese; sipezeka m'Chichewa. Masamba a m'zilankhulo zina amafotokoza pulogalamuyi kuti mupeze chidziwitso chokha.
strings.tierB.category.title: Pulogalamu yogulitsa m'galimoto (van sales) | FieldSales
strings.tierB.category.description: Pulogalamu yogulitsa kuchokera m'galimoto (van sales): ma invoyisi pa foni, sitoko ya galimoto, ndalama ndi maulendo. Imagwira ntchito popanda intaneti.
strings.tierB.category.h1: Pulogalamu yogulitsa kuchokera m'galimoto ya ogawa katundu ndi ogulitsa katundu wambiri
strings.tierB.category.intro: FieldSales ndi pulogalamu yogulitsa kuchokera m'galimoto ya makampani omwe ogulitsa awo amagulitsa ali m'galimoto m'njira za tsiku ndi tsiku. Wogulitsa amakweza katundu m'galimoto, amagulitsa pa sitolo iliyonse, amasindikiza invoyisi, amatolera ndalama ndi kulemba katundu wobwezedwa, zonse ndi app imodzi ya pa foni. Woyang'anira amaona zomwe zakwezedwa, zogulitsidwa, ndalama zotoleredwa ndi zotsala m'galimoto iliyonse.
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.title: Kodi pulogalamu yogulitsa kuchokera m'galimoto ndi chiyani?
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.body: Pulogalamu yogulitsa kuchokera m'galimoto, yomwe imatchedwanso pulogalamu ya route sales, imayendetsa njira yogulitsira imene wogulitsa amanyamula sitoko m'galimoto ndipo amagulitsa, kupereka katundu, kupereka invoyisi ndi kutolera ndalama paulendo umodzi. Imalowa m'malo mwa mabuku a ma invoyisi a mapepala ndi kuimbirana foni kumapeto kwa tsiku. Imalemba malonda aliwonse, malipiro ndi katundu wobwezedwa ngati zikalata, kotero sitoko ndi ndalama zitha kufananizidwa tsiku lomwelo. Kwa woyang'anira, imayankha mafunso atatu madzulo aliwonse: wogulitsa aliyense wagulitsa chiyani, watolera ndalama zingati, ndipo chatsala chiyani m'galimoto iliyonse?
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.title: Tsiku m'njira
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.body: Tsiku limayamba ndi kukweza katundu kolembedwa kuchokera ku nyumba yosungira katundu kupita m'galimoto. Pa sitolo iliyonse wogulitsa amasankha kasitomala mu app, amawonjezera katundu kuchokera pa mndandanda kapena ndi barcode, amapereka invoyisi ndi kuisindikiza pa pulinta ya thermal. Malipiro amalembedwa ndi lisiti, ndipo katundu aliyense wobwezedwa amalembedwa ndi chifukwa chake. Kumapeto kwa tsiku, zotsala m'galimoto zimatsitsidwa ndi kubwezeredwa ku nyumba yosungira katundu. Pakati pa masitepewa, woyang'anira akhoza kutsatira malonda, ndalama zotoleredwa ndi maulendo a wogulitsa aliyense pa dashboard ya pa webu osaimbira foni aliyense.
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.title: Yopangidwira malo a netiweki yofooka
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.body: Njira zogawira katundu zimadutsa m'zipinda zapansi pa nthaka, m'madera a mafakitale ndi m'midzi momwe netiweki ndi yofooka. App ya wogulitsa ya FieldSales imasunga makasitomala, zogulitsa ndi mitengo pa foni, kotero wogulitsa akhoza kupereka ndi kusindikiza zikalata popanda intaneti. Chikalata chilichonse chili ndi kiyi yakeyake, kotero chimafika kamodzi kokha, ngakhale kutumiza kubwerezedwa. Makampani a ku Saudi Arabia omwe atsegula kulumikizana kwa ma invoyisi a pa intaneti amafunika intaneti panthawi yopereka ma invoyisi ndi zikalata za katundu wobwezedwa. Malisiti, maulendo ndi makasitomala atsopano zimagwirabe ntchito popanda intaneti m'makampani amenewo.
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.title: Ndalama zotoleredwa ndi sitoko ya galimoto
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.body: Ndalama zomwe zili m'njira zimafunika kuyang'aniridwa mofanana ndi sitoko. Malipiro aliwonse amalandira lisiti ya nambala yomwe ingalumikizidwe ndi ma invoyisi omwe akulipira, ndipo ngongole ya kasitomala imasintha nthawi yomweyo. Sitoko ya galimoto imawerengedwa chinthu ndi chinthu ngati zokwezedwa kuchotsa zogulitsidwa, kuphatikiza zobwezedwa ndi zosintha zolembedwa, kotero oyang'anira akhoza kuifananiza ndi kuwerenga kwenikweni wogulitsa asanapite kunyumba. Katundu wobwezedwa akhoza kugawidwa ngati wamba, wowonongeka kapena wosinthanitsa, ndipo woyang'anira amasankha ngati abwerere ku sitoko ya galimoto yokonzeka kugulitsidwa.
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.title: Ndi ya ndani?
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.body: FieldSales ndi yoyenera ogawa katundu ndi ogulitsa katundu wambiri wa zinthu zogulitsidwa mwachangu (FMCG) monga chakudya, zakumwa, zotsukira ndi zodzisamalira, komanso kampani iliyonse yokhala ndi ogulitsa oyendera masitolo, magolosale ndi mashopu ang'onoang'ono m'njira zokonzedwa. Imathandizira kugulitsa kuchokera m'galimoto, maoda a pasadakhale (pre-sales) ndi kupereka katundu molunjika ku masitolo (DSD). Si ERP yathunthu: imalumikizana ndi dongosolo lanu la accounting kapena ERP kudzera mu API. Oyang'anira amalamulira zomwe wogulitsa aliyense angachite, monga kupereka kuchotsera, kugulitsa pansi pa mtengo wa pa mndandanda kapena kuwonjezera makasitomala atsopano.
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.q: Kodi kusiyana kwa kugulitsa kuchokera m'galimoto ndi pre-sales ndi kotani?
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.a: Pogulitsa kuchokera m'galimoto wogulitsa amanyamula sitoko ndipo amapereka katundu, amapereka invoyisi ndi kutolera ndalama paulendo umodzi. Mu pre-sales wogulitsa amatenga oda imene nyumba yosungira katundu imaipereka pambuyo pake. FieldSales imathandizira njira ziwirizi, kotero kampani ikhoza kugwiritsa ntchito magalimoto m'njira zina ndi kutenga maoda m'njira zina. M'njira ziwirizi, ma invoyisi, ndalama zotoleredwa ndi ngongole za makasitomala zili m'dongosolo limodzi, ndipo oyang'anira amaziona m'malipoti omwewo.
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.q: Ndingafananize bwanji sitoko ya galimoto kumapeto kwa tsiku?
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.a: FieldSales imaonetsa, pa chinthu chilichonse m'galimoto iliyonse, kuchuluka kokwezedwa, kogulitsidwa, kobwezedwa ndi kotsala. Fananizani zotsala ndi kuwerenga kwenikweni, lembani kusiyana kulikonse ngati kusintha kolembedwa, kenako tsitsani zotsala ku nyumba yosungira katundu ndi kayendetsedwe kamodzi. Galimoto imayamba tsiku lotsatira ili ndi sitoko yoyera yodziwika bwino.
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.q: Kodi wogulitsa wa m'galimoto amafunika zipangizo zanji?
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.a: Foni ya smartphone, Android kapena iPhone. Pulinta ya thermal ya Bluetooth si yokakamiza, ndipo imathandiza wogulitsa kupatsa kasitomala invoyisi kapena lisiti yosindikizidwa. FieldSales sigulitsa zipangizo ndipo sifuna mtundu wina wake wa pulinta. Oyang'anira amagwiritsa ntchito dashboard ya pa webu pa msakatuli wa kompyuta kapena foni iliyonse.
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.q: Kodi FieldSales ingalumikizane ndi dongosolo lathu la accounting?
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.a: Inde. FieldSales imapereka API yomwe imathandiza dongosolo lanu la accounting kapena ERP kusinthana makasitomala, zogulitsa, ma invoyisi, malisiti ndi mayendedwe a sitoko ndi pulatifomu. Gulu lanu kapena kampani yanu ya IT imamanga kulumikizanaku pogwiritsa ntchito zolemba za API.
strings.tierB.countries.title: FieldSales pa dziko lililonse: ndalama, msonkho, e-invoicing
strings.tierB.countries.description: FieldSales imatumikira ogawa katundu m'mayiko onse. Onani ndalama, msonkho wa malonda ndi momwe e-invoicing ilili m'dziko lililonse patebulo limodzi.
strings.tierB.countries.intro: FieldSales imatumikira makampani ogawa katundu m'mayiko onse. Kampani iliyonse imasankha dziko lake, ndalama ndi mlingo wa msonkho m'makonzedwe ake, ndipo ma invoyisi, malisiti ndi malipoti zimatsatira zimenezo. Kulumikizana ndi boma kwa ma invoyisi a pa intaneti kumagwira ntchito ku Saudi Arabia kokha. M'mayiko ena onse kumapezeka mukapempha. Tebulo ili m'munsiyi likuonetsa, pa dziko lililonse, ndalama za kumeneko, mlingo wanthawi zonse wa msonkho wa malonda kapena VAT, komanso ngati kulumikizana ndi boma kwa ma invoyisi a pa intaneti kukugwira ntchito kapena kumapezeka mukapempha.
strings.tierB.countries.columns.einvoicing: Ma invoyisi a pa intaneti a boma
strings.tierB.countries.einvoicingLive: Timathandizira kulumikizana kwa Gawo Lachiwiri ndi pulatifomu ya Fatoora ya ZATCA
strings.tierB.countries.taxNote: Ndalama ndi mlingo wa msonkho zimaikidwa ndi kampani iliyonse m'makonzedwe ake. Milingo ya patebulo lino ndi chitsogozo chabe ndipo ingasinthe; funsani mlangizi wanu wa msonkho za malamulo apano. Mzere (—) umatanthauza kuti palibe mlingo wanthawi zonse wolembedwa wa dzikolo.
strings.tierB.about.title: Za FieldSales
strings.tierB.about.description: FieldSales imapanga pulogalamu ya pa intaneti (cloud) ya makampani ogawa katundu omwe ali ndi ogulitsa. Inakhazikitsidwa mu 2026 ku Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
strings.tierB.about.body.0: FieldSales (dzina m'Chiarabu: فيلد سيلز) ndi pulatifomu ya pa intaneti (cloud) ya makampani ogawa katundu ndi ogulitsa katundu wambiri omwe ali ndi ogulitsa oyendera makasitomala. Kampaniyi inakhazikitsidwa mu 2026 ndipo likulu lake lili ku Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Imatumikira makampani m'mayiko onse, ndipo ndalama ndi mlingo wa msonkho wa dziko lililonse zimaikidwa m'makonzedwe a kampani yokha. Makasitomala athu ndi makampani omwe amagulitsa ndi kupereka katundu kudzera mwa ogulitsa a m'njira: ogawa katundu, ogulitsa katundu wambiri ndi opanga zinthu omwe ali ndi magalimoto awo ogulitsira.
strings.tierB.about.body.1: Timamanga dongosolo limodzi lolumikizana la ntchito yonse ya m'njira: ma invoyisi osindikizidwa kudzera pa foni ya wogulitsa, malisiti ndi ngongole za makasitomala, sitoko ya galimoto yoyang'aniridwa ndi wogulitsa, njira ndi maulendo okhala ndi malo ndi zithunzi, komanso dashboard ya pa webu ya oyang'anira. App ya wogulitsa imagwira ntchito pa Android ndi iPhone ndipo imapitiriza kugwira ntchito popanda intaneti, kenako imatumiza zonse intaneti ikabwera. Makampani akhoza kulumikiza FieldSales ndi dongosolo lawo la accounting kapena ERP kudzera mu API, kotero kuti zambiri za m'njira zisalembedwe kawiri.
strings.tierB.about.body.2: Timafotokoza pulogalamuyi momwe ilili. Timathandizira kulumikizana kwa Gawo Lachiwiri ndi pulatifomu ya Fatoora ya ZATCA. Kulumikizana ndi madongosolo a boma m'mayiko ena kumapezeka mukapempha. App imapezeka m'zilankhulo izi: Arabic, English, French, Turkish and Chinese; sipezeka m'Chichewa. Kuti mulankhule nafe, pemphani kotesheni, sungitsani msonkhano kapena titumizireni uthenga pa WhatsApp.
strings.tierB.contact.title: Lumikizanani ndi FieldSales
strings.tierB.contact.description: Lankhulani ndi gulu la FieldSales: pemphani kotesheni, sungitsani msonkhano kapena lankhulani nafe pa WhatsApp za pulogalamu yogulitsa m'galimoto.
strings.tierB.contact.intro: Tiuzeni mmene ogulitsa anu amagulitsira lero ndi zomwe mukufuna kusintha. Pemphani kotesheni, sungitsani msonkhano kapena titumizireni uthenga pa WhatsApp, ndipo membala wa gulu lathu adzakuyankhani. Makampani omwe amagwiritsa kale FieldSales akhoza kugwiritsa ntchito njira zomwezi kuti apeze chithandizo. Zimathandiza kutchula dziko lanu, chiwerengero cha ogulitsa komanso ngati amagulitsa kuchokera m'magalimoto, amatenga maoda kapena zonse ziwiri.
strings.tierB.contact.meetingIntro: Sungitsani msonkhano wa pa intaneti ndi gulu lathu. Tidzakuonetsani tsiku la wogulitsa mu app ndi dashboard ya woyang'anira, pogwiritsa ntchito zitsanzo zofanana ndi zogulitsa ndi njira zanu, ndipo tidzayankha mafunso anu okhudza kukonza.
